acquisition.reason: WIX Terms of Use prohibit data-mining/robots and commercial collection/use, copying, downloading, reproduction, distribution, and derivative works without express prior written consent.

confirmed_claims: Official WIX lookup supports Pass Car/Light Truck application search by Make, Year, and Model/Engine to return part listings.
Official WIX site exposes Quick Search and PDF Catalog pages, including Light Passenger Truck and Interchange catalogs.
WIX Terms of Use state website materials include data, data sheets, catalogs and files.
WIX Terms prohibit data-mining, robots, similar extraction tools, commercial collection/use of product listings, and commercial exploitation without express written consent.
WIX Terms identify a route for requesting authorization.

next_action: Do not automate or bulk-acquire WIX data. Retain WIX only as a manual spot-check/verifier unless written commercial permission is obtained. Move acquisition effort to the next source with acceptable reuse rights.
notes: Technical fitment capability is strong, but rights review blocks AutoSpec ingestion under current published terms.
